messages:
nora: quick postmortem follow-up: noticed a recurring mini-incident pattern where resolver transient errors cause immediate LB rotation + TLS fallback mismatches. need owners + short timelines.
ben: saw the same in traces at 11:03 UTC 1; many clients retried to fallback region after host was blacklisted for ~1-2s.
kai: log snippet:
```
2026-06-08T11:03:12Z lb.edge: resolver_error host=svc.internal err=SERVFAIL attempt=1
2026-06-08T11:03:12Z lb.edge: add_blacklist host=10.2.4.5 duration=2s reason=resolve_fail
2026-06-08T11:03:12Z tls.cache: sni_mismatch host=10.2.4.5
```
nora: propose small concrete actions:
- D1: resolver wrapper with 2 retries + 200ms jitter before returning failure (owner: kai). target: PR in 48h, canary 4d.
- D2: minimum DNS cache TTL = 20s configurable (owner: ben). target: config change tomorrow.
- D3: add metric+alert for rapid-resolve-rate + rotation spikes (owner: nora). target: dashboard in 2d.
kai: taking D1. impl note: in-process wrapper in lb-agent, TCP retry only for truncated responses. will add unit tests.
ben: making D2 change in staging now. will post diff in INC-4750.
infra-bot: Created INC-4750: https://tracker.internal/INC-4750 - "edge: resolver-transient -> rotate mitigation" assigned to triage
nora: please add PR links and test notes to INC-4750. syncing Fri for status. if anything blocks, tag eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
